BRRRR vs buy and hold: same equity, very different cash.

Both paths end with about $65K of equity. The difference is how much of your own money stays in the deal:

• Cash left in the deal: $13,700 vs $72,800
• Time to first rent: ~5 months vs ~1
• Cash flow: +$82 vs +$115 a month
• Cash-on-cash: 7.2% vs 1.9%

It's 2–2. BRRRR frees up your cash for the next deal. It just takes more work and more risk.

Example numbers: $160K purchase + $40K rehab, ARV $260K, refinance at 75% LTV.
